data.description: As a standard action once every 1d4 rounds, a lyrakien can tap into the divine power of Elysium, unleashing a blast of holy starlight in a 5-foot burst.  All creatures in this area take 1d4 points of holy damage, plus 1 point for each step their alignment deviates from chaotic good.  For example, a chaotic neutral or neutral good creature would take 1d4+1 points of damage, a neutral creature would take 1d4+2 points of damage, and a lawful evil creature would take 1d4+4 points of damage.  A DC %1 Reflex save negates this damage.  Chaotic good creatures are unaffected by this ability.
data.name: Starlight Blast
